members.name: John Anderson
members.role: Head of Learn to Play, Head Coach of Mites (8U)
members.bio: John grew up in Fredericksburg, VA and has been playing hockey since he was 7 years old. John and his wife Olivia have two young sons, Henry and Owen, who love to play hockey like their dad. John is returning as head coach of the 8U Mites team for a second season and is also looking forward to growing the Learn to Play Hockey program.

members.name: Jeff Walker
members.bio: Jeff Walker serves LYHA through marketing and IT. He and his wife, Emily, have three children, Ava, Owen, and Elijah. Owen is the Coyote in the family, and Jeff loves watching him play. Jeff hopes to help grow ice hockey in Central Virginia and make the sport easier for more families to find. He graduated from Johnson Bible College and owns NXTLVL-Digital, a web and digital marketing agency based in Gretna, Virginia.
